value.title: Worktree diff — version-correct indexing and search across worktrees
value.summary: Creating a worktree auto-registers and scans it; only files diverging from the main tree cost anything; search resolves the asking context's version. Phase 1 measures current behaviour (investigate mode); phases 2-3 build only the measured gaps.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Jordan's ask (2026-08-28, verbatim intent): 'we need to ensure our worktree diff works - so we can create worktrees and they auto get scanned and only changed files in there that diff from main branch are re-scanned, searching uses those versions etc.' Evidence that part of this already exists structurally: worktree_files rows are per-worktree (swallow's churn findings), content-addressing dedupes unchanged bytes, and the (blob,parser_version) skip makes identical-content re-scan cheap. Live evidence of the gap: bobolink (retro seat) found a worktree's uncommitted content is invisible to search unless the whole tree is added as a duplicate root (captured 2026-08-28). Phase 1 is a scripted measurement of what actually happens today; the phase-2 unit set is RULED BY THAT EVIDENCE, not by this draft. Second full validation run of the pij-team pipeline (PM #2).

sections.name: goals
value: A newly created worktree of a registered repo becomes searchable without a manual add.
Indexing a worktree costs zero provider spend for files identical to the main tree (measured, not assumed).
Search is version-correct: from inside a worktree you get that worktree's version of changed files, from main you get main's; cross-context hits are labeled.
Removing a worktree unreferences its divergent content cleanly through GC with no orphaned paid enrichment.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Branch-aware history indexing (only live worktrees on disk, not refs).
Cross-machine worktrees or remote diff resolution.
Changing the content-addressed storage model — this plan scopes discovery, reference-tracking, and query-time resolution only.

value.claim: A new worktree with K changed files becomes searchable without manual registration, and its scan enqueues enrichment only for divergent content (provider-call count proven for the unchanged remainder: zero).
Search from inside a worktree returns that worktree's version of a changed file; the same query from the main tree returns main's version; results carry which context they came from.
git worktree remove leads to the divergent-only content becoming unreferenced and GC-collectable, proven by before/after reference counts with zero orphaned paid enrichment.
The phase-1 probe script survives as a committed regression harness artifact runnable by any future seat.

value.title: Phase 1: Measure current behaviour (investigate)
value.brief: Investigate mode: scripted probes, each varying ONE variable, producing an evidence contract — not opinions. Probe set: (P1) create a worktree of a registered repo, touch nothing: is it discovered? what rows/jobs appear? (P2) edit K files: what is scanned, what is enqueued, what hits a provider (count calls via logs/DB deltas)? (P3) search the same query from main and from the worktree: which versions rank, is context distinguishable? (P4) remove the worktree: what becomes unreferenced, what does GC reap, anything orphaned-paid? Output: assets/probe-report.md with transcripts + the RULED phase-2 unit set. The probe script is a deliverable (ac-0005). PM-codeable solo per fan_out rules; interlock note: watcher-ignore fixes are on main (PR #38) so measurements are clean.
value.receipt: Phase 1 complete: probe harness + report committed at 0aaaac8; ruled unit set delivered to prime for the HARD sign-off gate. No coder spawned.

value.title: Phase 2: Close the measured gaps (parallel units — PROVISIONAL until phase 1 rules them)
value.brief: Candidate units, TO BE CONFIRMED/REPLACED by the probe evidence: (u-a) worktree auto-discovery (daemon/watcher registers new worktrees of known repos); (u-b) diff-scoped scanning (scan a worktree against the main tree's blob set rather than full-walking); (u-c) query-time version resolution + context labeling (query surface: prefer the asking worktree's version, fall through to main, expose --worktree/--branch scoping); (u-d) removal lifecycle (worktree remove -> dereference -> GC path). Each unit SRP behind interfaces frozen at the end of phase 1, worktree-per-coder, snap-in recipes, assumptions sections in done reports.

value.title: Phase 3: Composition + first light
value.brief: PM composes; first light is live: create a worktree of THIS repo, edit a file, search finds the worktree version from inside it and the main version from main, remove the worktree, show GC reclaim — the whole loop as one transcript, using our own pij-team worktrees as the test corpus. Reviewer (settings default) after composition; PR held unmerged for prime.
